_capture.note: SYNTHETIC, not a capture. The advisor document names a 'text plan' among the five fixtures the parser should be tested against, and no rung of this endpoint returns one. The four rungs measured return: no plan field at all, a metrics object, a plans object of graphs, and a base64 json_query_plans string. So this file is not evidence about the API. It exists because the document also names text-only and unrecognised shapes as normalisations to survive (line 571), and a parser that throws on an encoding it has never seen is worse than one that reports no plan. What it asserts is that the parser declines rather than crashes.
